title: Beast Spear
text: “Please calm your anger! Shield Hero!”
All the dignitaries are bowing their heads. What a magnificent sight—everyone bowing before my Father.
“Ah, if anyone tries to pull off a half-baked assassination attempt, it might be nice to have Motoyasu take care of them, don’t you think?”
“Leave it to me!”
I’ll step forward.
“I, Motoyasu, will carry out any command from my Father.”
“Then, outside the castle… yes. Aim your Magic at that mountain, just as you did at the border of Melromarc—and, of course, make sure no one gets killed, right?”
“Understood.”
I look out the window of the throne room and scan the distant mountain. I can’t tell if anyone’s there. But it should serve as a good warning.
“Liberation Firestorm X!”

I focused my mind, compressed the magic I’d created, and hurled it with all my might. The magical orb traced a streamlined path, flying past the castle… it cleared the wall before taking shape and began moving as a massive fiery tornado. Adjusting its speed to allow for escape… the massive fiery tornado slowly climbed to the middle of the mountain before exploding. Magma-like ground was now visible along its path.
“If I wanted to, I could destroy that mountain right before your eyes.”
“All right. But that’s… our next move.”
“Eek!”
My father’s piercing gaze is directed at the Siltvelt dignitaries, causing them to recoil. At the same time, it seems some are bowing deeply, as if in reverence for my father’s authority.

“Sure, I get that if someone powerful does something troublesome to us, it’s a problem, right? But we’re not going to just take a beating, and we’re not going to let ourselves be killed so easily either. Besides, Motoyasu-kun may be strong, but I want you to look at it from the other side.”
“W-what do you mean?”
“Even though he’s this strong… it seems Motoyasu-kun was defeated. By a wave that occurred in this world’s future.”
“W-what…!?”

I’ve figured out Father’s objective. Rather than flaunting his power and ruling through fear, he’s instilled the terror that a foe so powerful—one that even this strength cannot overcome—lurks in the future. My father replied with a sigh.

“It seems just being the Shield Hero is enough to have your life targeted, so we’ll at least protect ourselves. But if anyone tries to make us a scapegoat in a battle unrelated to the ‘waves’… just be prepared for us to crush them with everything we’ve got. Right, Motoyasu?”
“Understood. As long as my father lives, I, Motoyasu, will wipe out any nation that stands in our way, leaving not a trace behind.”
Usually, my Father would say something at this point to stop me, but this time he continues with a smile.

“Look, the Shield Hero can’t really defeat enemies on his own. So my policy is: no war. If anyone’s unhappy, they can leave, and if everyone wants to fight, then I’ll be the one to leave… After all, there’s no need for a Shield Hero, right? If you want to fight under the pretext of protecting people… go ahead and do whatever you want.”
He pauses for a moment. It seems everyone present understood just how forceful Father’s words were.
“So… shouldn’t matters like marriage proposals for me, or life in your own country… shouldn’t those things be dealt with after we’ve put an end to this crisis?”
“H-Ha-ha!”
And so, the assassin who dared to defy Father in Siltvelt was, on the surface at least, neutralized.
“Well, that’s enough formalities. I think they’ve understood they can’t assassinate us, so let’s get down to business.”
“Y-yes!”
“Next up, the Seven Star Hero of this country is coming for talks, right?”
“That is what we’ve been told. Also, there is a slight possibility that forces aligned with the Seven Star Hero are targeting the Shield Hero’s life.”
“If it’s just that much… I need to talk to that Seven Star Hero first, anyway. What kind of person is he?”
“He’s someone who devotes his attention to honing his skills; he’s been secluded in the mountains recently and hasn’t been appearing much for official duties.”
“Sounds like a warrior type. I think we’re no different, so don’t worry.”
“I thank the Shield Hero for his mercy.”

Thanks to what Father ordered, the country’s leading figures withdrew. Well, I have no idea what they’re thinking deep down, but they surely won’t do anything reckless in front of my Father. They’ve probably realized that poisoning a Hero isn’t something you can pull off easily, and they surely know that a sneak attack against my Father would be ineffective. As for the possibility that he’s an imposter claiming to be a god… they must have understood that from the presentation earlier, so they won’t be able to complain.
“Phew…”
My father leaned back against the throne, looking completely drained.
“Ah… I did it again…”
Just then, Éclair and the elderly man of the Genmu clan walked in, opening the door.
“I heard, Lord Iwatani. It seems you’ve caused quite a stir.”
“Ah, Ms. Éclair, I’m sorry. I got carried away because Sakura-chan and the others were about to poison me.”
“If I’d been there, I would’ve gotten angry too. That anger is your right. Don’t worry about it. In fact, I think it’s quite something to make someone like you, Mr. Iwatani, lose his temper.”

“Shield Hero, the way you declared that you don’t intend to wage war in our country… that alone is quite effective. The extremists will likely quiet down a bit because of this. In the meantime, you can work out arrangements with the other nations.”

“Yeah. It’s not like I want to unify the world or anything. It’s just… well. This might sound bad, but I want to travel around this world… I want to get to know it. It’s a dream I’ve discovered while traveling with Motoyasu, Éclair, Sakura, and the others since I was summoned to this world.”
Saying that, my Father looked at Éclair and me, then patted Sakura on the head. What an amazing dream! I, Motoyasu, will do my absolute best to help.
“Well, it’s a bit sudden, but we’ll make the necessary arrangements here.”
“I’m sorry.”
“Oh, don’t worry about it… Since it was something committed by our country’s people, the Shield Hero just needs to get ready for the Wave.”
“Thank you… I do regret going a bit too far. I’m sorry.”
The elderly Genmu-clan member waved his hand dismissively and continued talking with my Father. Motoyasu, who had grown drowsy along the way, took a quick nap while standing.
“So… wasn’t it said that the Seven-Star Hero would be arriving soon?”
The senior statesman returned to the throne room and explained today’s schedule. It was just then that the Seven-Star Hero arrived to have an audience with the Shield Hero.
“What kind of person is the Seven-Star Hero of Siltvelt?”
“They’re highly capable individuals, even by our country’s standards.”
Come to think of it, the Seven Star Heroes… have I ever met one before? I can’t quite recall. Though, I do seem to remember something unpleasant happening.
“I asked this earlier, but they’re the warrior type, right?”
“Yes.”
“What about their race? Are they from another world like us? I’m pretty sure the Seven Star Heroes can sometimes be from other worlds, right?”
“No, the Seven Star Heroes of our Siltvelt are chosen from among the people of this world and appointed to that role.”
“Is that so? I thought if they were from Japan like me, we’d have plenty to talk about.”
My father is looking my way. Well, of course—just like me, he might be able to build a bond with my father.

“His race is a werewolf… of the Warful clan. While they aren’t one of the four races that form the backbone of our nation, they are seasoned warriors. We can expect great results from him fighting alongside the Shield Hero.”
“A warrior, huh… I’m actually kind of looking forward to meeting him.”
Just as he was saying that, a soldier entered the throne room.
“The Hero of the Claws has arrived!”

With a clang, the doors to the throne room swung open, and the man known as the Hero of the Claws entered. He was a figure with blue fur… a werewolf-like figure with bulging muscles. His stride was light, yet he was powerfully built. He had scars here and there, and those scars seemed to enhance his masculinity… It was as if his scars were badges of honor. His upper body was half-naked, and he wore pants on the bottom. He seemed very agile.
“Hero of the Claw… you are in the presence of the Shield Hero. Release your transformation.”

When the representative of the Shusaku clan admonished him, the Hero of the Claw bowed deeply and then assumed his Demi-Human form. As for his age… how old might he be? The first thing that caught my eye was his sharp, battle-hardened gaze… He was a man with his hair slicked back.
His features weren’t bad at all. Late twenties to early thirties, perhaps? He exuded a certain maturity rather than youth… and I know there are some pigs out there who prefer men of this age.

He strode into the throne room with a light, brisk step. I stared intently at the Claw Hero. The Seven-Star Hero… My memory’s a bit hazy, and I can’t quite recall, but my instincts are whispering that I should have been on guard.
But more than that, I noticed my spear was rattling. Then it let out a high-pitched “ling” sound. What could it be?
Thinking that, I checked my stats, and the Weapon Book was reacting. When I opened it, the weapon it was reacting to was displayed.
The weapon’s name is Beast Spear.

If I recall correctly… oh, I believe this is the spear I found in the sanctuary of Filolial-sama and the others. This Beast Spear has a skill that automatically detects and attacks enemies. It also has various special effects, such as bonus damage against specific monsters… like “Demon Slayer.”
But why is it activating right now? Still… this must be fate, so I’ll give the Beast Spear a try.
“Huh?”
The moment I transformed the spear into the Beast Spear, it flew off on its own, locking onto the Hero of the Claws.
“Spear Hero! What are you doing!?”
“Motoyasu!?”
I hurriedly braced myself, but the spear fired an Air Strike Javelin all on its own.
